description: Use this with the private tracking token supplied for the user’s submission. Distinguish intake received, AI analysis, decision/reason, publication and notice evidence. Say received but blocked when held; do not call a held report successfully published, notified or resolved. Explain not_required as AI analysis not run and give the recorded reason and next step. Returns report-scoped verified public links and cluster candidates. Poll only pending outcomes. A queued notice is not sent; a send is not read or fixed. Final means this cycle ended. Never search another user’s receipt or guess identifiers.

tracking_token.description: Private tracking token returned when the report was prepared or submitted. Never guess report IDs.
